description: Record that this design record ANSWERED a question (ANSWERS) — the Decision, Requirement or Capability the user's reply actually became. Reads as a sentence: the RECORD answers the QUESTION. Take `question_id` from `open_questions`. DRAW IT AS YOU WRITE THE ANSWER IN, not at session end: this is the only thing that lets a later session tell an answer that reached the DESIGN from one that reached only the CHAT. Until it exists, nothing can — `loop_status` counts answered questions whose gap is still open and says outright that it cannot tell which is which. ITS ABSENCE IS NOT A CONFESSION. A question with no ANSWERS edge is one nobody has said anything about, NOT one whose answer went unwritten, and no report treats it as debt — every design written before 2026-09-02 has answered questions and none of these edges.

from_type.description:
Type of the design record that answered it — `Decision`,
`Requirement`, `Capability`, whatever the answer actually became.

note.description:
HOW this record answers the question — the sentence a later reader
needs when the answer is not obvious from the record alone.

question_id.description:
The Question this record answered. Take it from `open_questions`'
`question_id`.

name: answers
